# An ATX heading

Setext heading
==============

Second level, setext
--------------------

### Closed ATX ###

Plain text with *star emphasis*, _underscore emphasis_, **star strong**, __underscore strong__,
***both at once***, ~~struck~~, `code`, ``code with ` a backtick``, and a [link](https://example.com "with a title").

A soft line break
continues the paragraph, and a hard break  
ends a line, as does a backslash\
too.

Escapes stay as written: \*not emphasis\*, \_nor this\_, \[not a link\], 4\. not a list, \# not a heading.
Entities too: &amp; &copy; &#8212; and a bare & in text.

Snake_case_words, 2*3*4, a lone * star, [GPS] in brackets, and (parentheses).

Unicode: café, naïve, 日本語, emoji 🦊, and an em space between words.
